The 7-year period for an ordinary debt is sec. 5(1) of חוק ההתיישנות ('בשאינו מקרקעין - שבע שנים'), not sec. 5(a), and the 25-year judgment period is sec. 21. The evidence entry for it also cited a 404 Nevo URL with a PARAPHRASED snippet presented as a quote; both replaced with the wikisource consolidated text and the real verbatim wording.

PROCESS, the most important lesson of this cycle: fixing that last carry item INTRODUCED two fabricated legal powers. The first draft of Step 7 asserted the registrar can restrict a DRIVING LICENCE and can stop the debtor OPENING BANK ACCOUNTS. Neither exists: sec. 66a is a closed list of five (passport/travel document, exit ban, לקוח מוגבל מיוחד, כרטיס חיוב, founding or being a בעל עניין in a corporation), and the word נהיגה appears zero times in the entire statute. The Hebrew also mislabelled the cheque restriction as חייב מוגבל באמצעים, a different status that constrains the CREDITOR. All three came from a research summary that was transcribed rather than checked against the provision. Opening the statute took two minutes and would have prevented all three.

ALSO FIXED beyond the carry list: a scope gate in Step 1 (the suppliers law governs a purchaser buying in the course of business and supplies NO statutory due date for a private consumer client, and every downstream date inherits that answer); a new Step 6.5 on חדלות פירעון (a stay halts collection, and a תביעת חוב must be filed with the נאמן within a limited window or the debt is not counted, the one place in this workflow where inaction forfeits the debt); venue restated as a plaintiff's CHOICE rather than fixed by the debtor's address; interim attachment (עיקול זמני) for a debtor who is dissipating assets; the two dmei pigurim start dates reconciled; '75 days' corrected to a start-of-month maximum against about 46 at month-end; VAT Law sec. 7 (late-payment interest sits inside the VAT base); and a 404 Kol Zchut suppliers URL.

Deliberately NOT stated: the number of months to file a תביעת חוב. It could not be verified this cycle, so the skill tells the user to read the deadline off the published notice or the trustee's instructions and diarise it. Do not fill this in from memory next cycle; source it.

PANEL ROUND 2 found three MORE unsourced misstatements of the suppliers law and the Execution Law, all now fixed and evidenced: (a) the state-body term was written as cumulative ('within 45 days AND not later than shotef+30') when sec. 3(a) sets two ALTERNATIVE limbs and the contract decides which applies; (b) the local-authority clock was keyed to the month the invoice was ISSUED when sec. 3(f)(1) says הומצא, the month it was SUBMITTED, which is the same issue-vs-due confusion this cycle was fixing everywhere else; (c) the 30-day wait before filing a judgment for enforcement was stated three times as absolute when sec. 6(b) makes it residual (the date IN the judgment governs; where the judgment issued in the debtor's absence and the creditor served it, the 30 days run from service) and sec. 6(b1) lets the registrar allow earlier filing on affidavit.

Expert claim REJECTED after verification, do not re-litigate: the Expert asserted that a driving-licence restriction exists in the sec. 66a family for maintenance (מזונות) debts and that the skill's flat 'no such power' misstates the statute. The consolidated text does not support it: נהיגה appears ZERO times in the whole Execution Law, and sec. 66a(6) is marked (נמחקה). A sixth limb did once exist and was deleted, which is almost certainly what the Expert was remembering, so the skill now says exactly that in a parenthesis. The flat statement stands.

Expert ranked the remaining gaps and explicitly assessed all as log-not-block. #1 by outcome, and the one to take first next cycle: the PERSONAL GUARANTEE (ערבות אישית) from a controlling shareholder. It ranks first because its window closes permanently: the moment the debtor asks for time is the only moment a בעל שליטה will sign, Step 5.5 already has the user in exactly that conversation asking for post-dated cheques or a שטר חוב, and it is one clause in an already-correct paragraph. It is the difference between a judgment against an emptied company, which the skill itself says is worth nothing, and a collectable individual. #2 disputed debt (partly covered: Step 6 already routes a genuine dispute to a lawyer, but the mechanic that the שטרות shortcut COLLAPSES into a full court case on the debtor's objection is mentioned only in passing in Step 7 and is not connected to the dispute analysis). #3 individual debtor. #4 the phone call to check the invoice ever entered the payment run, which the Expert rates highest hit-rate-per-minute of anything in the document.
